text:
Mira K: PR #41299 ready for final gating — changes to async routing/fallback priority. Canaries tomorrow morning; need runtime + infra + sec signoffs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/41299

Alex P: quick ask — which routes are impacted? does this change default fallback order?

Mira K: Impacted: router/{orchestrator,policy}. Files: router/fallback.go, orch/route_planner.cc. Default fallback changed to prefer lightweight-variant -> quantized-variant -> hosted. Small param tweak to eviction threshold.

Jamie (runtime): I can take runtime review today. @Mira K can you paste the config diff?

Mira K: Sure — snippet below:
```yaml
fallback_priority:
  - lightweight
  - quantized
  - hosted
eviction:
  reuse_window_ms: 250
  aggressive_threshold: 0.82  # lowered from 0.9
```

Rick (infra): heads up — if reuse_window drops we'll see higher memory churn on p100 pools. Can we keep reuse_window at 300ms for dedicated?

Mira K: we tuned to 250 for latency SLOs. If infra wants 300 for p100, we can set per-pool override. Added an env flag `EVICT_REUSE_MS` for per-pool config.

Sasha (security): quick question — any new network calls or creds changes? also need to confirm KMS usage for rollout logs.

Mira K: no new external calls. logging uses existing KMS path /projects/redwood/keys/canary. added audit tag "fallback-change" to rollout metadata.

Alex P: devex: can you add a short runbook note for rollback? simple steps ok.

Mira K: done, added runbook section in PR description and linked a rollback job: `./scripts/rollback-canary.sh pr=41299`

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2025-05-02 09:00 UTC — slot booked (owner: Mira K). Reminder 1h before.

Jamie (runtime): I'll post review comments by EOD PT. Rick please confirm per-pool override acceptable.

Rick (infra): ok for 300ms default on p100, agree to per-pool override. lgtm pending tests.

Sasha (security): will sign off after verifying logs/KMS path. ETA 6h.

Mira K: thanks — tagging reviewers in PR: @Jamie (runtime), @Rick (infra), @Sasha (security). If all green let's merge after canary starts.
